title: Product reindex job with wrapped indexing errors
name: Product reindex job

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how errors are wrapped and given context as they move from the indexer to the job runner? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
catalog.loadBatch rejects with an error whose code is ETIMEDOUT. How does runReindexJob treat it on the first attempt?
choices: It retries, because rootCause reaches the original error and isRetryable sees ETIMEDOUT
It records the batch as failed immediately, because IndexingError has no code
It rethrows and aborts the whole job
It retries forever, since attempt is reset per catch

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the seen set in rootCause?
choices: It deduplicates log lines for repeated errors
It prevents an infinite loop if an error's cause chain contains a cycle
It caches root causes across calls for performance
It stops at the first non-Error cause

questions.prompt: A bulk response comes back with HTTP 200 but body.errors set to true. Which statement about the indexer's handling is accurate?
choices: The batch counts as indexed because status is below 300
The SearchClient throws before indexBatch sees the response
A SearchClusterError is thrown with status 200 inside the try block and is then caught and wrapped by the surrounding catch
